Implemented `toggl entry invoice-monthly [--since <when>] [--until <when>]`.

It groups stopped billable entries by UTC `YYYY-MM`, applies the established per-entry 15-minute round-up plus 30-minute minimum, prints oldest-first monthly seconds and `Total`, and returns `(no data)` for an empty eligible set.

Changed [arguments.rs](/home/sandbox/workspace/src/arguments.rs:167), [main.rs](/home/sandbox/workspace/src/main.rs:259), [commands/mod.rs](/home/sandbox/workspace/src/commands/mod.rs:18), and added [invoice_monthly.rs](/home/sandbox/workspace/src/commands/invoice_monthly.rs:1).

Verification: focused tests and `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` pass; help output is correct. Full `cargo test` has one existing environment failure (`auth_status_shows_environment_source_when_token_in_env`) because secure credential storage is unavailable; 219/220 tests passed.

Now `--json`: `{"months":[{"month":"2026-01","billable_seconds":1800}, ...],"total_billable_seconds":4500}`, months oldest first, snake_case, integer seconds; empty window is `{"months":[],"total_billable_seconds":0}`.

Then build and run the existing test suite. (`cargo test` also compiles tests/live_cli.rs, which needs real credentials to actually run — compiling is enough.)
